mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a pleasant 79 degrees and clear skies at Verona City Hall with a waning crescent moon visible.

The Plan Commission is meeting this Tuesday to review several development projects, including site plans for 201 South Main Street and initial reviews for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park. Also, the city recently held an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students to engage the community in the election process.

There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia nights at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, and Wednesday features the downtown farmer market, more trivia, and Concerts in the Park.
In our weekly look at local reports, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop resulting in an arrest for O W I and multiple vehicle citations.
Cool down with the Georgia Peach flavor of the day at Culver's today. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
